preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be equal to the length of the indices array.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) and 0 <= i < len(s) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: All elements in the indices array must be integers within the valid range of indices for the string s.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s must be valid alphanumeric characters.

postconditions.description: The output string must be a rearrangement of the characters in s according to the order specified by the indices array.
